plain: Side by side and alike; also a likeness drawn between two things

webster.text: In geometry, extended in the same direction, and in all parts equally distant.

example.quote: GEORGE NICHOLAS again drew a parallel between the power of the king of Great Britain and that of Congress, with respect to making treaties.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
